text:
maria: Heads-up — the runtime guide has a dead link under 'model onboarding' (curl example). found while triaging a customer report.
jon: ah thanks, which link? can you paste the snippet? :eyes:
maria: sure — the snippet points to `https://internal-cdn.redwood/runtime-examples/curl-v2.tar.gz` and returns 404 in staging.
docs-bot: auto-scan: https://internal-cdn.redwood/runtime-examples/curl-v2.tar.gz — 1 broken link detected (runtime-guide.md)
sam: i can pick this up today. is that the only affected page?
maria: i ran a quick grep, looks like the same shortlink is used in runtime-guide and onboarding-quickstart. only 2 references.
lexi: pinging owners: @maria owns runtime-guide and @sam for onboarding-quickstart?
jon: if you open a PR, please include the rehosted asset to S3 and update both references. add `docs: rehost curl example asset` in the title so it shows in the changelog.
sam: creating PR now, will rehost to `s3://redwood-docs-assets/runtime/curl-v2.tar.gz` and update links. assigning to @maria for review.
maria: thanks — i'll review and check the rendered snippet in staging. also add a short note in the PR about why the old host 404'd (expired shortlink) so we have context.
docs-bot: scan-schedule: nightly link-scan will recheck changed pages after merge.
jon: optional — could we add a tiny integration test that `curl --head` the URL in CI for the snippet? avoids regressions. up to you.
sam: good idea, i'll add a smoke test in the docs CI pipeline that checks the new S3 URL.
maria: LGTM, once CI passes merge and close the thread. i'll follow up if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
jon: cheers, thanks for the quick turnaround everyone.
